head: Chrome can now fill forms from your Gmail
dek: Chrome can now fill forms from your Gmail: order numbers, tracking details and flight bookings, suggested as you type.
details: Only with Gemini in Chrome and Personal Intelligence switched on (US first). You control it in Chrome's settings.
where: US first, Gemini in Chrome with Personal Intelligence
means: Less typing when you look up an order or a flight, but only if you let Chrome's Gemini see your Gmail.
todo: It only works with Gemini in Chrome and Personal Intelligence switched on. You control it in Chrome's settings.
